args.goal:
Profile all three uploaded CSV files (stores.csv, products.csv, sales_data.csv) to discover:
- Column names, data types, cardinality, and sample values for each table
- Data quality observations (nulls, duplicates, ranges for numeric columns)
- Semantic meanings (identify IDs, dates, amounts, categorical fields)
- Potential join keys across the three datasets (e.g., store_id, product_id)
- Row counts and key statistics for each file

This profile will be used to generate mechanical Bronze ingestion rules that map every column from source to a typed, metadata-enriched Bronze layer.

Generate a complete Bronze layer STTM (Source-To-Target Mapping) CSV that covers every column from all three source files (stores.csv, products.csv, sales_data.csv).

For each source column, produce a transformation rule that:
1. Specifies the source table and column name
2. Assigns a target Bronze column name (rename for clarity if appropriate, else keep source name)
3. Specifies the target data type (map string → VARCHAR, numeric → INT/DECIMAL, dates → DATE/TIMESTAMP)
4. Documents any type casts or transformations needed
5. Includes metadata rows for each table (row count, load timestamp, source file name)

Bronze is intent-agnostic: mechanically map every column without filtering. The STTM should have sufficient rows to capture all columns plus metadata from all three tables.
